title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be E = (√3 m g) / q.

title: Potential difference U_AB
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be U_AB = -(√3 m g L) / (2 q).

title: Maximum potential energy
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be (√3 m g L) / 2.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem, equating the change in kinetic energy to the work done by gravity and the electric field.

title: Geometry for potential difference
description: Important: The calculation for E must correctly use the horizontal displacement L - L cos 60° as the distance for the potential difference U_BA.

title: Potential reference handling
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate potentials at points O, A, and B, given that the potential at O is defined as zero.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for the work done by the electric field (qU_AB) in the work-energy equation.

title: Confusing U_AB and U_BA
description: Pitfall: Using U_AB instead of U_BA (or vice versa) in the formula E = U/d for the uniform field.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final answers should have correct units (N/C for E, V for potential, J for energy).
